goal: Keep the existing gated-run progress topbar continuously scoped to the active owning worktree across harness gate updates and worktree switches without remounting the desktop shell.

acceptance_criteria.outcome: The active terminal workspace renders exactly one element labelled Gated run progress for its matching registered run, including verifying, ready_to_test, done, and blocked feature states.
A harness event for the matched run updates the displayed status while the existing progress bar remains selected throughout the asynchronous refresh.
Switching away and back immediately restores the owning worktree's retained latest status, while a worktree with no matching run renders no progress bar.
The focused Vitest regression command exits successfully.
The desktop UI production build command exits successfully.

tasks.objective: Make useWorktreeHarnessRun retain and select confirmed snapshots by normalized workdir, reject stale asynchronous responses, and add focused state-sequence and progress-markup regressions.
contracts: Preserve useWorktreeHarnessRun(workdir) returning { run, refresh } and preserve GatedRunBar/GatedRunBarView props.
Reuse findHarnessRunForWorkdir for normalized ownership; never expose a cached run to a different requested workdir.
Keep the last confirmed matching run selected while an event-triggered refresh is pending, but evict it when an authoritative list has no match.
Ignore stale list/status completions so an older response cannot replace a newer confirmed snapshot.
Retain one subscribeHarnessEvents stream for the mounted hook and the existing event-driven reads; add no polling, store slice, or test dependency.
non_goals: Do not edit App, Terminal, GatedRunBar production markup, RecoverableRenderErrorBoundary, or worktree navigation/store behavior.
Do not change harness routes, event types, gate semantics, backend state, session attachment, retry, or unlink behavior.
Do not show or duplicate the progress bar on non-terminal pages or non-owning worktrees.
Do not redesign the topbar or perform broad render-performance refactors.

targeted_gate.command: cd crates/agentum-desktop/ui && npm exec vitest run src/hooks/useWorktreeHarnessRun.test.ts src/components/gated-run/GatedRunBar.test.tsx

final_gates.command: cd crates/agentum-desktop/ui && npm exec vitest run src/hooks/useWorktreeHarnessRun.test.ts src/components/gated-run/GatedRunBar.test.tsx
